presets.description:
Phase-machine topology (research_adr) that carries a topic from ground through
parallel research threads, synthesis, ADR authoring, and plan authoring — each
phase gated by an inner doc-review loop and an outer human review-lane verdict.
Personas: researcher (multi-instance fan-out), synthesist (Research document
author), adr-author (ADR document author), planner (Plan document author),
doc-reviewer (inner quality gate). No persona writes to the filesystem directly;
all authoring goes through engine proposals. Human applies via the dashboard
review lane.

profiles.description: Use the team's normal model resolution chain with no profile overlays.

profiles.description:
Mixed-provider provider-axis lane: the researcher fan-out, the research-document
synthesist, the ADR author, and the planner run on the codex app-server provider;
the inner doc-reviewer keeps the team default (claude). Proves cross-provider
collaboration authors real documents end to end. Codex auth is the file-based
persisted ChatGPT session in the Codex home; no credential env is injected.

presets.description:
Single vaultspec-doc-editor worker, no supervisor. Applies a
natural-language instruction to one target vault document as a single
whole-document proposal through the engine authoring tools. No
filesystem write of any kind (agent-flow D2/D7) — divergent from
vaultspec-solo-coder, whose worker retains filesystem_write for
ordinary paths.

absent.
